basic_details.job_title: IIT Jodhpur Assistant Project Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur) has announced 3 vacancies for the Assistant Project Manager post on a project-based engagement for 12 months, with possible extension. Eligible applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree with 1-year relevant experience or a Graduate Degree with 3 years relevant experience. The pay is specified as Rs. 29,000-1,500-44000 (Upto). Candidates can apply online through the provided official portal link under advertisement number IITJ/RD/I/INST/RD/OH/20110014/2026/177. The last date to submit the online application is 16 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official online portal at Apply Online.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Assistant Project Manager at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur)
12 Months, with further extension on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and experience requirements to be eligible for the Assistant Project Manager position.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree with 1-year relevant experience Or Graduate Degree with 3 years relevant experience
rows.desirable: Project management form endorsement application process, day-to-day communication, records and files management. Or HR & Establishment matters like payments, salary preparation, fellowship, HRA certificates, leave management, attendance records, employee grievances, and RTI matters. Or knowledge of Accounting and Finance related work, project receipts, expenditure, and Tally. Proficiency in MS Office and good communication skills for drafting and organizing meetings.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation for the Assistant Project Manager position is structured up to Rs. 29,000-1,500-44000. The initial tenure of the appointment is 12 months, which may be extended further on a year-to-year basis depending on satisfactory performance according to institute norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jodhpur Assistant Project Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official online portal at Apply Online . Fill out the online application form with the required details before 16-10-2026 at 11:55 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe a detailed written examination or interview process beyond stating the tenure, age limit, and essential qualifications required for shortlisting.
